column1: # ci-runs.tsv: every GitHub Actions run cited by the audit package, with its jobs. Read with `gh run view <id> --repo MihaiCatalinVoicu/GHOST --json databaseId,workflowName,event,headSha,createdAt,updatedAt,conclusion,jobs` on 2026-10-04 (read-only). Times are UTC.

# A job that never started carries its queue time in job_started_utc; a cancelled job carries the time of the cancellation in job_completed_utc. Job names are as GitHub shows them (long names are truncated by GitHub).
# The repository is private and GitHub keeps job logs for 90 days, so this file is the auditor's only view of these runs; the numbers read from the logs are in ci-log-facts.tsv.
